difficulty_reason: The lemma is the dimension-bound form of the preceding criterion: if H^p(V, H^q(E)) vanishes for p greater than a fixed d and negative q over a covering family, then E is the derived limit of its truncations (statement lines 5439-5453). The proof rewrites the dimension bound in the shape required by the preceding lemma of the same section (proof lines 5455-5458) and applies it (proof lines 5458-5460). The non-formal content is the bookkeeping that turns the two-parameter bound into the one-parameter one. The claim is H2: one reduction to a companion criterion.
